scope: Selected-hero research in tutorial plaza; no new control implementation.
observation: One candidate control flag follows a unique hero through two identical four-hero cycles. Game code tests this flag while counting controlled team actors.
team_lookup: Code inspection identifies an indexed team-identity lookup used by the team actor lookup. Identities have not yet been matched to live fixed D-pad slots.
limitations: Candidate flag is not yet a supported per-player ownership contract.
Dead heroes, multiple local players and arbitrary team compositions are untested.
Direct D-pad hero selection and contextual X are not implemented.
No visual, audible, device playback or FPS acceptance.
